description: Huita IMS MCP connector: products/inventory (multi-store, batch/expiry), sales & purchase orders, AR/AP, and business analytics. Provides 14 read + 6 analytics + 12 write tools (preview→commit two-phase writes). Data syncs in real time with the Huita desktop and POS clients.
